text: Keep furniture within ten meters of your character.
Without shelter, sitting near a fire caps comfort at one.
Hearth gives its extra comfort only within eight meters.
Fires must be lit to provide comfort.
Hot Tub provides comfort only when fueled and heated.
Only the highest comfort piece in each category counts.
A Campfire in a dungeon entrance can restore a ten-minute Rested effect.
Wet prevents Resting, except while sitting in a Hot Tub.
Rested lasts seven minutes plus your comfort level.
Rest for twenty uninterrupted seconds, away from hostile creatures, to gain Rested.
